summary: MSD Investment Corp., a Maryland BDC, filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 disclosing that its Board extended the Commitment Period for its ongoing private offering of common stock by one year, to December 21, 2027. The offering involves capital commitments from accredited and non-US investors, funded via drawdowns. This is a routine administrative extension of an existing continuous offering, not a special situation. No terms, pricing, or strategic event are involved. Watch for any future announcements regarding final closing or fundraising progress.
